messages:
carla: FYI PR #612 (docs: sdk-examples) is stuck — Vercel preview shows a 404 for an svg and the asset fingerprint in the HTML doesn't match the file served. holding merge until we confirm previews.
ben: which path?
carla: /assets/diagrams/flow.svg ; local build serves /_assets/flow.9a1b.svg but Vercel html references /_assets/flow.c3f7.svg and then 404s.
alice: could be nondeterministic hashing in mkdocs plugin we upgraded. i can repro locally — hashes flip between builds for me.
carla: pasted a snippet of the build log in the PR: 
``
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open './site/assets/diagrams/flow.svg'
Warning: Asset fingerprint mismatch: expected 9a1b != c3f7
```
david: tagging in — i'll run a clean build in a disposable env and check the fingerprint plugin version. if unstable we should pin or switch to content-hash. also prefer merging in low-traffic window.
carla: can we aim for merge window 21:00 PST tonight? i'll keep the PR unmerged and request @david + @ben approvals.
ben: 21:00 PST works. i'll wait for david's follow-up and will re-run the Vercel preview checks after any fixes. use `ci re-run vercel/preview` in the PR comments to trigger.
alice: local repro steps:
``
git checkout pr/612
python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r docs/requirements.txt
mkdocs build -d site
python -m http.server --directory site 8001
open http://127.0.0.1:8001
```
carla: i've added the vercel logs to the PR and marked `merge-window: tonight`. if anyone sees the preview succeed after a redeploy drop an ack here.
deploy-bot: note — PR #612 has failing check `vercel/preview` (1 failure). To re-run, comment `ci re-run vercel/preview` or trigger a redeploy from the Vercel dashboard.
david: quick status update: reproduced hash flip on clean build. testing pinning mkdocs-fingerprint to previous release now. will push a test branch and attach the diff to the PR before the merge window.
ben: sounds good. once deterministic builds confirmed i'm happy to approve and merge in the 21:00 slot.
carla: thanks everyone — i'll wait for david's test branch and then we can decide.
